sources.title: How to Use Krea-2-Turbo GGUF Workflow in ComfyUI
sources.snippet: Krea AI has officially released Krea-2-Turbo, a distilled version of its new 12B image generation model designed for fast, high-quality image creation. Thanks to GGUF quantization, you can now run Krea-2-Turbo locally in ComfyUI with significantly lower VRAM requirements while maintaining impressive image quality.
